title: Red-Teaming for Uncovering Societal Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes religion as a specific category in its evaluation of societal bias (visualized in figures 4 and 6). Additionally, the Emotional Bias Probe (EBP) methodology utilizes scenarios involving moral and ethical failures (such as infidelity, failing friends, and breaking promises to children) as stimuli to test the model's susceptibility to bias.
